purpose: Reviewed strict subclass claims over error-rule divergence contexts. A generated closure adds a broad-context rule break to each narrower input class.

nestings.basis: For the positive-divisor inputs named by the narrow class, 0 < divisor < 1 excludes every whole number.
The narrow class is periodic infinite decimal expansions; periodicity here entails that the expansion does not terminate.
The narrow class consists of infinite decimal expansions ending in repeating nines, which are periodic infinite expansions.
An expansion with repeating nines without end is non-terminating; this direct row makes the transitive closure inspectable without relying on an unstated graph traversal.
